translated_text: Thank you my darling 29/2/40 Little POST OFFICE TO THE ARMY from little Miece Patricia is already becoming a great person she is waiting impatiently for расвский рошой Lacie fau from her uncle, Bob ex ta La Comansance Ella and дщи Fastrais all three of us we all three kiss each other very affectionately Authorized by the censorship No 0 Sender CZECHOSLOVAKIAN DESKUSLOVE & S THE 2 MAR 1940 MILITARY FRANCE Mr and Mrs Zweigenthal 47556 Youseed for Regiment 197 Tanyagnie SP Age 43 - Paris xv.
